theater_main_quest_02_05_06_001:
Ah, the lovely Sword Princess!
Would you do me, Hermes, the honor of a dance?
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_004:
Oh, come ON! What is with that?!
Grrrrrrr!!
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_009:
What kind of man would I be,
abandoning a lady I asked to dance—
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_010:
—So, Bell!
Dance with the Sword Princess in my place!
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_013:
I'm counting on you. Don't go dragging this
god's name through the mud, okay?
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_020: May I have this dance, my lady?
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_027: Would you...do me the honor of a dance?
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_034:
Calm down. Don't just stare at your feet.
Look up.
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_035:
It's all right, Sir Bell.
As long as you don't step on her feet,
you can still turn the battle around.
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_036:
You're an adventurer, aren't you? Look each
other in the eye. You don't need
technique—just read her.
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_037: Gentlemen, ladies, are you enjoying the banquet?
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_042:
Hello, Hestia. I hear my children
had quite the run-in with yours the other day.
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_044:
My child was gravely wounded by yours.
I'd like to demand appropriate compensation.
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_045:
Wha...?!
What's that supposed to mean?!
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_046:
Bell came home hurt too, you know!
You can't just pin it all on—
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_047: Can you still say that after seeing this?!
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_050:
Bell...?
Did you really do this...?!
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_052:
I'm told your side struck first. There are
witnesses. You can't talk your way out.
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_056:
Ngh... Give me a break! I'm not playing along
with this farce!
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_058:
Oh...? So you refuse to admit guilt no matter
what, Hestia?
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_061:
Then I have no choice! The Apollo Familia
hereby challenges you to a War Game!!
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_066: Now I kinda wanna see it!
theater_main_quest_02_05_06_067:
If we win...
your follower, Bell Cranel, becomes mine!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_001:
—Now that's no good, Hestia~
Keeping such a cute boy all to yourself~
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_002: So that was your goal from the start! You creep!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_003:
How cruel. Didn't we whisper sweet
nothings to each other in the heavens?
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_004:
Don't you lie to me!
I turned you down on the spot!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_005:
Anyway! There's no way I'm going along with
this farce!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_006: I've got no obligation to accept any War Game!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_014:
A "War Game"...
That's a duel between Familias...right?
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_015:
Yeah. An all-out battle fought
under rules both sides agree on.
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_016:
The winner takes everything from the loser.
Members, money, the whole shebang.
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_017:
That Apollo... He knows you're the only
one in our Familia, and he still pulls this...!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_018:
Today I'll go into the Dungeon with Welf
and Lili, and then come straight home.
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_019:
Okay, I'll cut my shift short too.
Let's have a nice, quiet night together.
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_023:
What's all the racket so early in the
mornin', nya~?
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_028:
Looks like it, nya~
Maybe it's the white-haired kid's Familia!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_029:
Mmmph!
Anya, shut your trap, nya!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_034:
That Apollo... Going straight for brute
force, huh?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_036:
It's an attack by the Apollo Familia.
Why, you...! How dare you wreck
Bell's and my love nest!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_044: He slipped away in the smoke.
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_045: Attacking us right in the middle of town?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_01_050:
Bell! Just head for the Guild!
The enemy can't touch us there!
theater_main_quest_02_06_02_012:
Why not surrender?
I'd rather not rough up someone
who's about to be one of us.
theater_main_quest_02_06_02_020:
He's fast on his feet... It's no use anyway,
so he might as well just give up.
theater_main_quest_02_06_02_021:
Daphne—
I really think provoking that boy
is a bad idea.
theater_main_quest_02_06_02_022: What? Another one of your prophetic dreams?
theater_main_quest_02_06_02_023:
Yeah.
A wounded rabbit leaps over the moon
and swallows up the sun.
theater_main_quest_02_06_02_024:
If this keeps up, something terrible
is going to happen that we can't undo—
theater_main_quest_02_06_02_025:
Yeah, yeah. Quit talking nonsense.
We're going after him too.
theater_main_quest_02_06_02_026:
Ah...!
Why won't anyone believe me~?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_03_002: Yes. For Mr. Bell to be this late...
theater_main_quest_02_06_03_003: Am I the only one with a bad feeling about this?
theater_main_quest_02_06_03_007:
The Apollo Familia just started
a fight right in the middle of town!
theater_main_quest_02_06_03_008:
And it's against the Hestia Familia! They say
the Little Rookie's getting ganged up on!
theater_main_quest_02_06_03_011:
Yeah! The whole Apollo Familia is out
chasing Argonaut all over the place!
theater_main_quest_02_06_03_012: The whole city's in an uproar!
theater_main_quest_02_06_03_014: Don't get any funny ideas, Ais.
theater_main_quest_02_06_03_015:
This isn't like when you helped him on the
18th floor. Please don't do anything that
would help the Hestia Familia.
theater_main_quest_02_06_03_018: Sorry, Bell. I'm holding you back...!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_001:
You have to stop them right now!
Send notice to the Apollo Familia immediately!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_002: Tell them fighting in the streets is punishable!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_003:
It's pointless. They've surely already
accepted whatever penalty we hand down.
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_004:
But...! Even as we speak,
the Hestia Familia is under attack!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_005:
Even so, there are limits to how far
the Guild can intervene.
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_008:
I despise you for receiving Lord Apollo's favor—
more than I can bear. But this is what
my patron god desires.
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_009:
I shall make you a member of our glorious
Familia.
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_013: Don't you howl at me, rabbit!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_030: This is why I hate upper-class adventurers...
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_034: No matter. You can't escape now.
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_035:
Bell, are you okay?!
Hang in there!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_040: Looks like you're having fun here.
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_044:
You lot... You dare defy
the mighty Apollo Familia?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_045: I cannot abandon an ally in peril!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_053: Miach! What are you doing here too...?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_054:
When I heard the commotion, I went to ask
Takemikazuchi's Familia for help.
I'm glad we made it in time.
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_057: Mr. Bell, let's get out of here!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_062: There he is! It's the Little Rookie!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_067:
Bell, we've gotten way off course from the
Guild! Head north from here!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_070: We'll take care of things here.
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_071:
Mr. Bell, you two head for the Guild!
We'll catch up as soon as we're done here!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_076:
I know! But are you sure we'll really
be okay without Mr. Bell?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_077: Yeah. The way I am now—
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_078: —I think I can hold my own pretty well.
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_080: Don't space out on me, Li'l E!
theater_main_quest_02_06_04_081:
Look who's talking, Mr. Welf! Don't let them
sweep your legs out from under you!
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_005: So this is where you were, Arde.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_008:
Good to see you looking so well.
I'd been told you were dead.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_010:
Ngh!
Li'l E, what are you doing?!
What happened to my backup?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_013:
Mr. Welf, Lili is going back to the Soma
Familia. Please tell Mr. Bell that I won't
trouble him anymore.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_015: Hey, Li'l E, where are you going?! Hey!
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_016: Dammit... What the hell is going on?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_019:
Dammit, where'd he go?!
Find him!
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_024:
The Guild's still a ways off.
And there are probably plenty of pursuers.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_026: Can you hear me, Bell Cranel?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_028:
Wherever you hide, we will keep hunting you!
Surviving this moment changes nothing.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_029:
It's the same aboveground or in the Dungeon!
Know that you'll never know a day of peace
again!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_032:
Bell, listen to me.
At this rate, we have no future.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_033:
We've got two ways out.
Either we take on a fight we can't win—
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_036:
As long as I've got you,
I'll be fine wherever we go.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_037:
I'll keep running away with you for the rest
of my life, until they finally give up.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_045:
I love you, you know?
You're so cute, I can hardly stand it.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_046:
I want to be by your side forever...
I don't want to hand you over to anyone.
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_048: Bell, how do you feel about me?
theater_main_quest_02_06_05_053: There he is! In the waterway!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_001: Grrr! Butting in at the most important moment!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_002:
That's it, I've had it! Bell! Southwest!
Not north—head southwest!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_004:
The enemy's home...
The Apollo Familia's...
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_005:
Apollo! I know you're in there!
Open this gate right now!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_006:
Why, hello, Hestia.
What brings you all the way out here?
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_007: ...Hey, little Prum, lend me that glove.
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_013:
Fine by me!
I'll take you on!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_017: Everyone, we have a War Game!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_019: Somebody file the War Game with the Guild!!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_022:
It's been ages since we had a festival like
this!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_024:
We'll decide the rules fairly, with the gods
as witnesses. I'll send word with the details.
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_027:
Yeah. More importantly...sorry.
Li'l E got taken by the Soma Familia—
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_032:
Bell. We'll rescue your supporter, no matter
what. You do what you need to do.
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_036:
I'll stall for as long as I can before the
War Game. In the meantime, you need to get as
strong as you possibly can!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_037: That's...the only way we can win.
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_039:
Stronger than anyone, anything,
that came after us today!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_040: You can do it—no, only you can do it!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_043:
Please, I'm begging you!
There's something I really need to ask!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_044: Please let me see Ms. Ais Wallenstein!!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_047:
Asking Ais to back you up in a War Game?!
Have you no shame?!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_052:
Get out of here, now.
You think we'd let you pull a stunt like that?
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_060:
Ais saw you coming to our home.
Then it clicked, and we had Tione
put on a little act!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_061:
We can't exactly meet you out in the open,
right~?
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_063: I heard about the War Game.
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_064:
My Familia has its circumstances, but...
I don't think abandoning you is right.
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_065: I want to win the War Game!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_069:
I'll help too! Go beat that Apollo Familia
into the ground, Argonaut!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_070: Thank you so much, Ms. Tiona, Ms. Ais!
theater_main_quest_02_06_06_071: I'm going to get stronger... For everyone!
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_008: Lord Soma, it is I, Zanis.
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_009:
Liliruca Arde, who had gone missing, has
returned.
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_010:
She has had a change of heart, and from now on
will work for the Familia's sake—
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_011:
Lord Soma!
Please let Lili leave the Familia!
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_015: And here I wondered what you'd say...
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_016:
Arde. If you wish to leave, there's a price.
Surely you understand that?
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_018:
Let's see... To repay the debt you owe
Lord Soma for raising you all this time—
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_019:
—you'll need to come up with, say,
ten million valis.
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_020:
Ten mil...?!
There's no way I have that kind of money—
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_024: You really are a fool, Arde.
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_025:
That god cares about nothing but brewing.
No matter what you ask, he'd never listen.
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_026:
Besides, wanting to leave? Isn't that
breaking our agreement?
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_027: So this is where you were, Arde.
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_030:
Good to see you looking so well.
I'd been told you were dead...
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_032:
...Why?!
Why are you helping the Apollo Familia?!
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_033:
We were asked to, of course, but
we have our own reason to join this fight.
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_038:
We can't leave you in the hands of another
Familia. Justice is on our side!
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_042:
The Hestia Familia, which deceived you,
threatened you, and used you,
will soon be destroyed...
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_044:
Please don't lay a hand on Mr. Bell and the
others anymore! Lili...will go back to Lord
Soma!
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_046:
I did as you asked and pulled back our men.
Now it's your turn to work for the Familia.
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_048:
Why, you have rare transformation magic,
don't you?
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_049: ...! How do you know about that?
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_050:
Lord Soma told me. Even a god like him
will at least listen to his own captain.
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_052:
You will devote your whole life to the Familia—
and to me. Fwahahahahaha...
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_057: The War Game's almost here, nya!
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_058:
But I heard Lady Hestia hasn't been showing up
to the gods' meetings. Is that true, nya?
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_059:
Come to think of it, I haven't seen Whitey
around either. Don't tell me he's planning to
run...
theater_main_quest_02_07_01_063: Ahh... Hope you're right, nya. Yeah.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_001:
We've finally found where your supporter's
being held.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_002:
It's the Soma Familia's brewery along the
waterway.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_003:
Tomorrow they're shipping out liquor from there.
Security will be thin that night,
so that's when we strike.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_004: Lady Hestia, may I ask you something?
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_006:
Right now, the Hestia Familia's top priority
should be winning the War Game—
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_007:
Even if we rescue Liliruca Arde, someone
from another Familia can't fight for you.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_008:
Do we really have time to spare on her right
now?
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_010: As things stand, Bell can't fight.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_012:
Right now, Bell is desperately trying
to get stronger for the War Game.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_014:
But as long as we leave your supporter behind,
there's no way Bell can show his true strength.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_015:
That boy knows how weak you are alone.
He knows how strong friends make you.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_016:
Besides, I made a promise.
I told him to leave the supporter to us.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_017: A goddess can't go breaking her promises!
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_018:
It's all connected. Saving your supporter
is what will give Bell his strength.
theater_main_quest_02_07_02_021:
Yes, of course!
Understood! We'll help!
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_002: Don't tell me she's absent again today!
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_003: She's out sick. It can't be helped.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_004:
Apparently being chased around by Apollo's
children gave her a terrible fever.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_005:
She's fakin' it, I bet.
Itty-Bitty's probably packin' up
to skip town in the night, ya?
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_008:
How unbecoming, refusing to face the music.
In that case, I'll have to ask the Guild
to declare a win by default...
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_011: Hey there, sorry to keep you waiting.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_012:
If we win this War Game,
I take Bell Cranel.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_013: I want to make that much perfectly clear.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_016: Make sure you write that down properly, scribe.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_017:
So? What's the format gonna be? Mess this up
and nobody's gonna get hyped, ya know?
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_019:
Bell's the only one in my Familia.
Let's make it a one-on-one between champions.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_020:
Heh. Isn't having so few members your own
negligence, Hestia? Don't use that as an excuse.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_022:
Let's widen the field and hear everyone's ideas.
How about we draw lots from the proposals?
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_023: You want me to draw something this important?
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_024: You're neutral. We can trust you.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_031:
It was a fair draw.
I won't hear any objections, Hestia.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_033: Of all the options, he drew that one...
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_034:
Of all things, the format where numbers
matter most...
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_035:
Defending a castle all alone would be
impossible. I'll let Hestia take the
attacking side.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_037: Sorry, mind if I butt in?
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_038:
I'm not saying this just because I drew it—
but the gap here is just too big.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_039: Why not let Hestia's side bring in a helper?
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_040:
Absolutely not!
A War Game is a battle between Familias.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_041: If we allowed helpers, the sacred rules would—
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_043:
Does a single helper really shake your
confidence so much? Is that all your love for
your children amounts to?
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_049:
D-don't mock me!
Fine, I'll allow a helper.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_052: And they must be from a Familia outside Orario!!
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_058:
The terms are clearly stacked against us, but—
considering the load on Bell, I'll gladly take
even one extra helper.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_059: But do you have anyone in mind?
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_060:
A skilled adventurer from outside Orario, no
less.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_061:
I've got a candidate.
I plan to leave the negotiating to Hermes.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_065:
...Terrible. You really haven't harmed Mr.
Bell or Lady Hestia and the others, have you?
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_066:
Ah... Of course not. More importantly, a
profitable job's been settled. We'll make a
killing using your transformation magic.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_068:
You came after Lili out of nothing but greed,
and helped corner Mr. Bell and Lady Hestia—
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_070:
I want the Divine Wine Lord Soma makes!
Money, women, food—I want to devour
every pleasure this world has to offer!
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_072:
I love this Familia. No matter how much dirty
work I do, our god never scolds me. I can do
whatever I please!
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_075:
Oops.
Anyway, you're cooperating. Tomorrow morning,
we head into the Dungeon and—
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_078:
Seems some rats have snuck in.
Word is there's a little goddess with them.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_080: I see. Then we'll have to exterminate them.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_081:
Wait! That's not what we agreed!
You said you wouldn't hurt Lady Hestia—
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_082:
They're the ones who attacked. It can't be
helped.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_083: Then Lili won't cooperate with you!!
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_084: Then I'll make you drink the Divine Wine.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_086:
Craving the wine, you'll become an obedient
servant in no time. You remember, don't you?
That pleasure...
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_088: Chandra, keep a close eye on her.
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_091:
(Somehow, somehow I have to get out
and help Lady Hestia and the others escape!)
theater_main_quest_02_07_03_094:
I can't stand that guy.
I'll look the other way. Do as you like.
theater_main_quest_02_07_05_001:
(Lady Hestia... Mr. Bell...
 I don't understand either of you!)
theater_main_quest_02_07_05_003:
(Someone as filthy as Lili...
 Why do they say they need me?!)
theater_main_quest_02_07_05_004: (Why do they say it has to be Lili?!)

theater_main_quest_02_09_06_004: You had me worried, collapsing like that.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_006: Don't overthink things. It's not like you.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_009: Hm? What's this all of a sudden?
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_010:
Nothing, I just thought I should
thank you properly.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_011: And Lili and Ms. Mikoto, too.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_012:
I'm really happy. That we all get to live
together in the same home.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_013:
It's kind of strange, isn't it?
When we first met, I never imagined
it'd turn out like this.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_014:
Well, sure.
I sure didn't think so either.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_018:
And with Ms. Mikoto, we first met when they
dumped monsters on us.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_019: Ha, now that you mention it, yeah.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_020: But she's saved us so many times since then—
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_021:
She even left her own precious Familia
to come help us in the War Game—
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_022: I could never thank her enough.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_025:
And Lili taught me all kinds of things,
when I didn't know anything.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_026:
Because Lili was there, I became
a real adventurer.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_027:
She's always by my side.
My very first companion.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_032: The Goddess is the one who found me.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_033: She gave me a place to belong.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_034:
Every single day since I came to Orario—
the Goddess gave me all of it.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_035:
People sometimes call her a useless goddess,
but to me she's more precious than anything—
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_036: She's the best goddess there is.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_038:
Seems like all I ever do is take
from everyone.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_042:
Just like you think we've saved you,
you've saved us too.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_043:
Supporting each other like that—
that's what a Familia is.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_050: I'm so happy to have a child like you!!
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_056: Let me go to my adorable Bell———!!
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_057:
Seems I was trying a little too hard
to look cool.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_058:
But—
I'm done with that now.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_059:
I'll pay back the money no matter
how many years it takes.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_060:
So I want all of you to support me,
even like this.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_061: I want you to help me.
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_062: I'm a hopeless goddess drowning in debt, but—
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_067: Then, to the Hestia Familia's new voyage—
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_069: Pwah! If only this were booze instead of water!
theater_main_quest_02_09_06_073:
Perfect timing.
We're about to have dinner. Won't you
join us, Chigusa—
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_009: I'm taking Ms. Haruhime with me.
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_011:
Huh...!
What the heck is that... The city...
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_015:
Wh-why are you here... Oh, I get it, it's you
lot. You piece of craaaap!
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_019:
I-I'm sorry! Forgive me?!
I'll do anything. Oh, I know! I'll give you
this body!
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_020:
I'll let you have me. You can do whatever
you want with me. Tempting, ain't it?
C'mon, this body, this beauty...
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_021:
Goddesses would run away barefoot!
Even your patron goddess Freya can't compare!!
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_034:
To rescue you, obviously.
You gave me quite a scare when we found you
collapsed in the courtyard.
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_036:
We're looking for him too.
Where on earth could he be...
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_039: Please, go to the Hanging Garden.
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_040:
...That's a good look on you. But I can't
just say "Sure thing" and let her go.
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_041:
Leaving a Familia comes at a price...
You get that, right?
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_042:
Besides, even if Haruhime runs from this
Familia, someone else'll hear about her power
and pull the same thing as today.
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_044:
...Ms. Haruhime is suffering right now.
So I'm going to save her.
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_045:
Get ready.
When a man carries off a woman,
he does it by force. That's how it goes.
theater_main_quest_02_10_03_049:
What an idiot... Waiting for the Level Boost
to wear off. But—
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_002:
...It's Bell Cranel?
All this, for that one brat...?
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_004:
Long time no see, Ishtar. Have you been well?
Let's get right to it. Or rather...
shall we call it a farewell?
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_013:
Wait! I-it was just a whim, Freya.
I had no idea you were so hung up
on that boy.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_015:
Ishtar. I've laughed off your little pranks
until now, but—
not this time. I won't forgive you.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_016:
That boy will be mine, no matter what...
I won't tolerate any woman who lays a hand
on him. I'm going to crush you.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_018:
Ah, what have I done!
My heart aches!
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_019:
I'm the one who told Ishtar about Bell.
And now look what it's come to...!
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_020:
Sigh... So how much of this went
according to plan...Lord Hermes?
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_021: I tossed a spark. That's all.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_022:
I honestly didn't expect it to go this far.
Ishtar's jealousy was just far greater
than I predicted.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_023:
And Lady Freya's love leaned far more toward
him. Above all, Bell turned out to be far
more—
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_031:
[If thou desirest the Empress's girdle,
 prove it]! [Fill me, pierce me,
 slay me—prove it]!
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_035:
Is your goal the destruction of the Ishtar
Familia? Or entertainment? Or perhaps...
a trial?
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_036:
The world longs for a hero.
Mortals and gods alike.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_037:
Even one little girl like her is longing for
one.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_052:
Our game of tag is over.
I'm all tired out.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_054:
.....................! Listen, Freya!
I'll tell you something interesting!
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_055:
A god's "Charm" doesn't work on Bell Cranel!
Don't you want to know his secret?!
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_056:
Heh. If that's true, he's all the more
wonderful. It makes me want him all the more.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_057: But I don't need to hear it from your lips.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_062:
You "Charmed" my man...?
Are you saying your beauty surpasses mine...?!
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_063:
Why?!
What's the difference between you and me?!
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_066: What else could it possibly be?
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_071:
Let this be a lesson, and no more pranks,
Ishtar. Though it may be too late for that.
theater_main_quest_02_10_04_074:
She's been sent back to the heavens.
She can never come back to the mortal world.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_003:
Show these Orario adventurers the might
of the Kingdom of Rakia!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_007:
The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Cavalry have been
blown away!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_008:
Infantry units 1 through 12 have been
blown away!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_009:
Everyone else—basically, they've all been
blown away!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_013:
Ms. Aisha... Thank you so much for everything.
If it weren't for you, by now I'd be—
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_014:
Ugh, cut it out, so gloomy!
I just did what I wanted.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_016: What are you going to do now?
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_017:
Hmm, what indeed.
For starters, I think I'll pay the Rakia army's
camp a visit.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_019:
The Ares Familia.
That's the huge army attacking Orario right now.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_020:
Huge only in numbers. No matter how many thousands
of ordinary soldiers they have, they're no match
for adventurers with honed Statuses.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_021:
Ares and his outdated ideas.
What a pain.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_023:
Well, who wins doesn't matter to me.
Wherever there are men, there's work
for us courtesans.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_025:
You still hung up on that?
Haruhime, you're always so—
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_028:
Haruhime, you're free now.
From here on, just live your life your way.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_030:
Heh...
And you'd better take responsibility,
Bell Cranel!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_032:
If anything happens to this klutz,
you'll answer to me.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_038:
By the looks of it, Haruhime still thinks
she was a proper courtesan, huh.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_039:
Right? She faints just from seeing a naked
man, so she never once—
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_040:
Let it be. No need to spoil it now.
Those two believed it, and they got through it.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_043: I see, I see. So everything's resolved!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_044:
So Haruhime's joined Hestia's family, eh...
Yep, that's a relief for me too.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_045:
I'm grateful to you, Lord Hermes.
For telling me about the Sessho Stone.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_046:
Nah, I just let it slip.
The "hero" who saved her is you, Bell!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_047:
Nngh... I was just desperate.
All I could think of was Ms. Haruhime.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_048:
Bell, have you ever heard of
the "Three Great Quests"?
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_050:
It's about the world waiting for a "hero"
to appear. Just like Haruhime was back then.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_051:
The Three Great Quests are the greatest
wish the world places on Orario!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_052:
They call for slaying three monsters that
escaped the ancient Dungeon to the surface.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_053:
The King of the Land, Behemoth. The Lord of the
Seas, Leviathan. Those two have already been
slain by the strongest Familias.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_057:
Once called the strongest in Orario's history—
the Zeus and Hera Familias.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_058:
They joined forces to challenge the third
monster, and—
they were wiped out.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_060:
The name of the third monster is
the Black Dragon.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_061:
The Black Dragon...! You mean the one-eyed
dragon from "Dungeon Oratoria"?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_062:
—A body of endless pitch-black, wings like
the dark of night. A living calamity, a living
legend, a living apocalypse.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_063:
It's no fairy tale. The Black Dragon truly
exists in this world. The Three Great Quests
have yet to be fulfilled.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_065:
The world longs for a hero. Remember that.
Every adventurer in Orario has what it takes.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_068:
What is going on?!
Why is my glorious army being pushed back
like this?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_069:
It's simple. Orario's adventurers are
monstrously strong.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_071:
Our soldiers are being captured, and we can't
even hold the front line. Let's go home,
Lord Ares.
theater_main_quest_02_11_01_073: This was a war we never had a chance of winning.
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_004: Wow, cooking for six must be a lot of work.
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_012:
—Whaaat are you two having so much
fun with...?
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_017:
I just decided. From now on, in my Familia,
boys and girls touching hands is BANNED!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_028:
That's tyranny! Banning all contact between
boys and girls?! It'll affect our
Dungeon expeditions!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_031:
Working around that is what makes
a good adventurer or supporter, isn't it?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_032:
Impossible is impossible! Then no contact for
you either, Lady Hestia! Don't you touch
Mr. Bell from now on!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_035:
B-but I'm the patron goddess!
If you say that, I can't even update
his Status!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_037:
Isn't working around that what makes
a good god?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_044:
Anyway!
Fine, contact can't be helped, but
no lovey-dovey stuff!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_045:
Loose morals make loose hearts!
No impure relations! NEVER!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_047: You're the impure one, Lady Hestia!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_048: How dare you say that to a virgin goddess!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_049:
...Um, this ban on relations with the opposite
sex... Does it apply to gods too?
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_051:
Yeah, I was wondering about that.
I've got my...relationship with Lady Hephaistos
to think about...
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_055:
It's fine, it's fine!
Romance between gods and children
is totally welcome!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_056:
Isn't it a dream? Just like the romance songs
of spirits and children that were popular
before we descended!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_058: Hey, what do you think, Bell?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_060:
Give me a break! Gods are fine, but mortals
aren't? That's way too unfair!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_063: Then I don't care about any of that anymore!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_066:
If a certain wonderful goddess confessed
her love to you one day...
what would you say?
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_073:
First of all, it would never happen.
And even if it did, I couldn't possibly
with a goddess.
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_082: She won't be back for a while after that.
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_086: That way of putting it was a bit much...
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_087:
B-but the Goddess is a goddess...!
She's someone to respect!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_089:
...Mr. Bell. If you swapped "god" and "mortal"
for "adventurer" and "supporter,"
could you still say the same thing?
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_091:
If someone never even considers you, just
because of your status or what you are... Isn't
that heartbreaking for the one with feelings?
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_094:
...Goddess...
I'm going to go find her.
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_102:
..................Tch. Not one decent man
here... Guess it's got to be a general or
nothing.
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_105:
Aisha! I hear there's a lively knight over
there! Let's eat him up!
